note: Obtains a raw pointer to XRefEntry from the entries array for the stream object being parsed
Sets the Parsing flag on the entry pointer which is still valid at this point
Resolves the indirect Length reference (5 0 R), triggering XRef::fetch which calls getEntry for the referenced object
Called for the Length object whose entry type is xrefEntryNone, triggering lazy loading of previous XRef section

The prev XRef section declares entries beyond current capacity (>1024), causing resize which reallocates the entries array. The entry pointer saved in makeStream is never refreshed after this reallocation.
Reallocates the entries array to a new memory location, invalidating all existing pointers into the old array
Uses the dangling entry pointer to read the flags field (4-byte READ) from freed memory - heap-use-after-free
